items.title: SK On’s Hungary plant earns Ford’s top Q1 quality certification
items.summary: Ford awarded its top Q1 quality certification to SK On’s Ivancsa plant in Hungary, underscoring strong supplier quality and a positive local outlook.
items.evidence: Ford grants Q1 status after assessing suppliers on production technology, product quality, improvement efforts, and manufacturing and quality management systems.

items.title: Red Bull Ford Had F1’s Yardstick Engine All Year. Sepang Finally Gave It a Win.
items.summary: Ford's Red Bull power unit earned its first F1 win but faces reliability penalties and extra engine usage issues.
items.evidence: Red Bull Ford power unit had its first Formula 1 victory, with Verstappen crossing the line 2.307 seconds clear of Kimi Antonelli at Sepang on October 4.

items.title: SK On’s Iváncsa Battery Plant in Hungary Receives Ford Q1 Certification
items.summary: Chinese battery material investment unrelated to Ford's Hungarian operations.
items.evidence: Lopal Tech announced that its second-tier controlled subsidiary, Shandong Liyuan, plans to invest in and construct the “Shandong Liyuan LP-15 Project” in the Juancheng County Chemical Industry Park, Shandong Province.

items.title: Eris Ford – Lifeline | Bless The Mic

items.evidence: Eris Ford came through to Bless The Mic with her song “Lifeline.”

items.title: Jiří Štěpnička, Czech voice of Harrison Ford and theater veteran, dies at 79
items.summary: Czech actor who dubbed Harrison Ford dies; no material impact on Ford's Hungarian business.
items.evidence: Actors’ Association President Ondřej Kepka described Štěpnička as “the Czech Harrison Ford,” saying his distinctive delivery had become inseparable from Ford’s characters for local audiences.

items.title: TOM FORD to Open First Store in Armenia
items.summary: Tom Ford opens in Armenia; article only briefly notes Z&A's plans in Hungary, unrelated to Ford Motor Company.
items.evidence: Z&A, which has operated in the fashion industry for 20 years, already represents several major international labels in Armenia, Georgia and Hungary.

items.title: Ryan Gosling talks 'Blade Runner 2049' and working with Harrison Ford in compelling new interview
items.summary: Interview mentions filming in Budapest and Harrison Ford, but does not discuss Ford Motor Company's Hungarian operations.
items.evidence: He also went on to talk about being served 'meat in a cone' while filming in Hungary.

items.title: BYD now has 1.02 million employees – more than Toyota, GM, Ford and Tesla combined
items.summary: BYD's upcoming Hungarian factory signals competition that could pressure Ford's operations in Hungary.
items.evidence: Its factories in Thailand, Brazil and Hungary are coming online as tariffs in Europe, Brazil, Mexico and elsewhere push the company toward local production.
